    The ray table of A₀ #

    Setting 8.4 for A₀: "A₀ = kP … identified with kP by Proposition 4.14. We use its normed homogeneous ray basis." The basis of Proposition 4.14 (basisA0) consists of one vector on each nonzero deck-homogeneous piece A₀(x, y)_g; its multiplication table is the ray table P (A0Tab), with the weight [x, y, g] ∈ W(P) of Definition 7.1 (cls) and the degree given by the length mesh weight. Rays with the same endpoints and the same weight are equal, since both lie in one length degree and the length pieces of a corner are lines (lines, Lemma 3.7 for A₀). By Theorem 4.? A₀ is representation-finite, so the table carries Setting 8.4 (A0Sys).

    The basis vector of the piece (x, y, g) lies in the corner e_y A₀ e_x of the opposite algebra, so the table has source y and target x.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
